reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the scenario and substance class remain inside the governed screening scope of the reference mass-balance kernel.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Scientific review should first confirm that a deterministic screening kernel is being used inside its declared applicability boundary.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review whether key runtime-consumed parameters are scenario-specific, governed defaults, or preserved-only descriptors.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Parameter provenance affects how much confidence can be placed in the resulting concentration surfaces.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Acknowledge the main deterministic uncertainty drivers before reusing the output in assessor-facing decisions.
reviewChecklist.rationale: The scientific review packet should make uncertainty communication explicit even without probabilistic modeling.

reference_mass_balance.packetTemplate: Build a scientific review packet that preserves screening scope, parameter provenance, benchmark context, and deterministic uncertainty drivers for the native reference mass-balance kernel.
reference_mass_balance.briefTemplate: Summarize whether the reference mass-balance run is scientifically reviewable within the declared screening boundary, highlighting applicability, parameter provenance, and top uncertainty drivers.
reference_mass_balance.acceptableOutcomeTemplate: Use the run as a screening-support artifact within the declared reference mass-balance scope.
reference_mass_balance.qualifiedOutcomeTemplate: Use the run only with explicit qualification notes because screening-use caveats remain material.
reference_mass_balance.escalationOutcomeTemplate: Escalate the run for deeper model review or additional evidence before decision-facing reuse.

driverActionTemplates.heuristic_parameter: Prioritize replacing heuristic parameter inputs with measured or higher-confidence evidence where feasible.
driverActionTemplates.unsupported_runtime_parameter: Do not treat preserved-only parameters as if they were actively modeled by the runtime.
driverActionTemplates.unexecuted_treatment_assumption: Clarify which treatment assumptions remained provenance-only and were not executed numerically.
driverActionTemplates.default_screening_capacity: Document when governed screening capacities dominate the concentration scaling and whether scenario-specific capacities are available.
driverActionTemplates.default_heavy_parameter: Document where governed defaults drove the result and consider scenario-specific overrides for sensitive decisions.
driverActionTemplates.time_bucket_interpretive_burden: Confirm bucket semantics and comparison window alignment before assessor-facing interpretation.
driverActionTemplates.multi_medium_simplification_burden: Consider a richer model family if intermedia dynamics are central to the decision context.
driverActionTemplates.evidence_conflict: Resolve conflicting evidence or qualify the affected output before reuse.

reference_mass_balance.applicabilityNote: Use this review profile for native deterministic concentration runs that rely on the governed reference mass-balance kernel.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the scenario remains inside the governed screening scope of the advective screening kernel and that a residence-time term is scientifically reasonable.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Scientific review should verify that adding first-order clearance is justified rather than implying richer spatial transport behavior.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review whether runtime-consumed residence-time and degradation parameters are scenario-specific overrides or governed defaults.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Residence-time defaults can strongly influence concentrations when advective clearance dominates loss.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Acknowledge deterministic uncertainty drivers before reusing the output in assessor-facing decisions.
reviewChecklist.rationale: The review packet should make screening-capacity, treatment, and multi-medium simplification caveats explicit.

advective_screening_mass_balance.packetTemplate: Build a scientific review packet that preserves advective screening scope, residence-time provenance, benchmark context, and deterministic uncertainty drivers.
advective_screening_mass_balance.briefTemplate: Summarize whether the advective screening run is scientifically reviewable within the declared concentration-only screening boundary.
advective_screening_mass_balance.acceptableOutcomeTemplate: Use the run as an experimental screening-support artifact when the governed advective assumptions fit the scenario.
advective_screening_mass_balance.qualifiedOutcomeTemplate: Use the run only with explicit qualification notes because residence-time, default, or treatment caveats remain material.
advective_screening_mass_balance.escalationOutcomeTemplate: Escalate the run for deeper model review or additional evidence before decision-facing reuse.

driverActionTemplates.heuristic_parameter: Prioritize replacing heuristic parameter inputs with measured or higher-confidence evidence where feasible.
driverActionTemplates.unsupported_runtime_parameter: Do not treat preserved-only parameters as if they were actively modeled by the runtime.
driverActionTemplates.unexecuted_treatment_assumption: Clarify which treatment assumptions remained provenance-only and were not executed numerically.
driverActionTemplates.default_screening_capacity: Document when governed screening capacities dominate the concentration scaling and whether scenario-specific capacities are available.
driverActionTemplates.default_heavy_parameter: Document where governed defaults drove the result and consider scenario-specific overrides for sensitive decisions.
driverActionTemplates.time_bucket_interpretive_burden: Confirm bucket semantics and comparison window alignment before assessor-facing interpretation.
driverActionTemplates.multi_medium_simplification_burden: Consider a richer model family if spatial hydrodynamics or intermedia exchange dominate the decision context.
driverActionTemplates.evidence_conflict: Resolve conflicting evidence or qualify the affected output before reuse.

advective_screening_mass_balance.applicabilityNote: Use this review profile for the non-default advective screening family when a governed residence-time term is scientifically justified.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the imported result shape remains within governed adapter normalization behavior.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Imported concentration surfaces are only scientifically reviewable when unit, basis, and compartment mappings are governed and explicit.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review whether imported surfaces preserve enough provenance and parameter context for downstream assessor interpretation.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Adapter outputs inherit both source-engine semantics and Fate MCP normalization constraints.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review the governed normalization-parity context and the top deterministic uncertainty drivers before comparing imported results to native outputs.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Contract-level normalization parity and imported-output limitations should be explicit in any scientific review.

external_result_adapter.packetTemplate: Build a scientific review packet that emphasizes governed normalization, imported-output limitations, and normalization-parity benchmark context without implying source-engine scientific equivalence.
external_result_adapter.briefTemplate: Summarize whether the imported concentration surfaces remain scientifically reviewable after governed Fate MCP normalization, while keeping source-engine caveats explicit.
external_result_adapter.acceptableOutcomeTemplate: Use the imported run as a governed normalization-support artifact within the declared adapter scope.
external_result_adapter.qualifiedOutcomeTemplate: Use the imported run only with explicit adapter, source-engine, and contract-scope caveats in the review record.
external_result_adapter.escalationOutcomeTemplate: Escalate the imported run when normalization caveats or applicability gaps materially affect interpretation.

driverActionTemplates.heuristic_parameter: Clarify whether preserved heuristic descriptors affect downstream interpretation of the imported surfaces.
driverActionTemplates.unsupported_runtime_parameter: Keep preserved-only imported descriptors separate from modeled behavior in assessor communications.
driverActionTemplates.default_heavy_parameter: Document which Fate MCP defaults were used to contextualize the imported result.
driverActionTemplates.time_bucket_interpretive_burden: Review imported time-bucket boundaries and source-engine timing semantics before comparison.
driverActionTemplates.multi_medium_simplification_burden: Avoid overinterpreting multi-medium imported surfaces without source-engine context.
driverActionTemplates.evidence_conflict: Resolve conflicting imported evidence or qualify the normalized output.

external_result_adapter.applicabilityNote: Use this review profile when Fate MCP is normalizing an external engine's concentration outputs rather than producing native concentrations.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the adapter stub is being treated as an illustrative interface path rather than scientific evidence.
reviewChecklist.rationale: The adapter stub exists to exercise contracts and interoperability, not to support production scientific conclusions.

adapter_stub.packetTemplate: Build a scientific review packet that keeps the adapter stub clearly inside illustrative, non-production review scope.
adapter_stub.briefTemplate: Summarize the adapter stub run as an interoperability exercise, not a scientific decision artifact.
adapter_stub.acceptableOutcomeTemplate: Treat the stub run as an illustrative interoperability artifact only.
adapter_stub.qualifiedOutcomeTemplate: Retain explicit non-production caveats if the stub artifact is reused in demonstrations.
adapter_stub.escalationOutcomeTemplate: Stop and replace the stub path with a real model family before any scientific decision use.

driverActionTemplates.unsupported_runtime_parameter: Keep stub-only preserved fields clearly separated from scientific interpretation.

adapter_stub.applicabilityNote: Use this review profile only for illustrative adapter validation and regression workflows.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the run is Level I or Level II equilibrium screening only and not Level III intermedia-transfer modelling.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Scientific review should prevent overinterpretation of fugacity outputs.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review molecular weight, Henry law constant, Koc, and Level II half-life provenance.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Fugacity outputs are highly sensitive to physchem inputs and scalar half-lives.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Acknowledge equilibrium partitioning uncertainty and deferred Level III/routing scope before downstream reuse.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Review packets must preserve screening-only interpretation.

fugacity_equilibrium_screening.packetTemplate: Build a scientific review packet for experimental Level I/II fugacity equilibrium screening with physchem provenance, equation traces, and boundary caveats.
fugacity_equilibrium_screening.briefTemplate: Summarize whether the fugacity run is scientifically reviewable as experimental equilibrium partitioning screening.
fugacity_equilibrium_screening.acceptableOutcomeTemplate: Use the fugacity run only as experimental equilibrium partitioning screening support inside the declared boundary.
fugacity_equilibrium_screening.qualifiedOutcomeTemplate: Use the fugacity run only with explicit qualification notes because physchem, equilibrium, or default caveats remain material.
fugacity_equilibrium_screening.escalationOutcomeTemplate: Escalate beyond the current experimental fugacity screening kernel when Level III transfer, routing, calibration, field validation, or decision-facing model adequacy is required.

driverActionTemplates.heuristic_parameter: Replace heuristic physchem inputs with measured or higher-confidence evidence where feasible.
driverActionTemplates.unsupported_runtime_parameter: Do not treat unsupported descriptors as if they were used by the fugacity runtime.
driverActionTemplates.unexecuted_treatment_assumption: Clarify which treatment assumptions remained provenance-only.
driverActionTemplates.default_screening_capacity: Document when governed screening capacities dominate fugacity partitioning.
driverActionTemplates.default_heavy_parameter: Consider scenario-specific capacity or half-life evidence for sensitive decisions.
driverActionTemplates.multi_medium_simplification_burden: Escalate if non-equilibrium transfer or spatial routing dominates the question.
driverActionTemplates.evidence_conflict: Resolve conflicting physchem evidence before downstream reuse.

fugacity_equilibrium_screening.applicabilityNote: Use this review profile only for the experimental fugacity_equilibrium_screening family.
